evidence: Reviewed docs/agents/flow-docs-sync.md, docs/flows/README.md, docs/flow-manifest.json, docs/flows/download.execute.mmd and docs/flows/contracts.md.
Compared candidate source and tests against base 81de7ca83b25537cf69f692404590f929a0421a6, including task_manager.py retry and cleanup paths, download_files.py publication, and nas.py upload.

task_manager.py runs publication and NAS upload through separate retry calls, retains the active slot across download retries, and handles cancellation, pause and storage-close failures; the diagram reflects those boundaries.

tests/test_daemon_downloads.py covers download retry exhaustion and recovery, publication retry and exhaustion, cancellation and pause during retry waits, and failed attempts with storage-close failures. tests/test_nas.py covers resuming an upload after a sidecar failure.
limitations: This was a read-only semantic review; I did not execute the application or tests, and no test execution evidence was supplied.
The diagram does not cover individual site extraction or segment download implementations, service restart recovery, or all subtitle processing, consistent with the documented scope.
